Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset type: finished Open Graph social sharing image for The Twilight Passport, a Twilight film marathon viewing party website.
Create one polished WIDE LANDSCAPE image with an exact 1.905:1 aspect ratio (1200 x 630 composition; high resolution preferred). Use the three supplied reference portraits as identity, wardrobe, and illustration-style references, not as edit targets: reference 1 Edward Cullen, reference 2 Jacob Black, reference 3 Charlie Swan.
Subject: all THREE characters together, recognizably the same faces as these reference illustrations. Edward is pale with tousled bronze hair and a charcoal coat, Jacob is warm and athletic in a brown leather jacket and dark tee, Charlie resembles lean middle-aged Billy Burke with a mustache, worn tan overshirt, gray tee, and a plain silver beer can clearly visible in his hand. Keep Charlie lean and slightly world-weary, not muscular or glamorized. Exactly three characters, no additional people.
Composition: editorial movie-poster illustration, Edward, Jacob, and Charlie grouped across the RIGHT 57 percent, shown from about thigh up, all three faces separated and unobstructed. Give the LEFT 43 percent to a huge clean logo. The characters emerge from a misty Pacific Northwest evergreen forest at blue hour, with a luminous full moon behind them. Moonlit blue-silver rim lighting, a little warm amber on Jacob, sage tones on Charlie. Hand-painted romance novel cover meets premium narrative video game key art, beautiful restrained brushwork, rich midnight teal and ink blue, no photographic collage.
Text, exact and only: "TWILIGHT" in very large elegant luminous ivory-silver display serif lettering on the left; directly below it "PASSPORT" in smaller widely spaced capitals. The wordmark must be large enough to read at tiny link preview size. Keep every letter fully inside the frame with generous safe margins. Avoid anything behind the lettering that reduces legibility.
Constraints: one finished flat image, full-bleed background, no card frame, no browser mockup, no badges, no extra captions, no watermark, no hard edge between text and characters. All faces, the logo, and the beer can must fit safely inside the central 90% of the canvas.
favicon:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: square favicon and app icon master for The Twilight Passport website.
Create one extremely simple, iconic FULL MOON centered on a flat very dark midnight teal-blue background (#091820). Square 1:1 image, 1024 x 1024. The moon is a complete perfect round luminous pale silver-blue disk, diameter about 72% of the canvas, with a crisp clean circular silhouette. A handful of very subtle large soft lunar maria shapes in muted blue-gray give it the feeling of a Twilight moon, but the disk should read as a simple clean full moon when reduced to 16 pixels. Minimal painterly texture, restrained and elegant, soft luminosity confined to the edge, no distracting outer glow.
Constraints: ONE full moon only. No crescent, no phase shadow, no forest, no stars, no clouds, no border, no words, no initials, no logo lettering, no tiny details, no 3D sphere highlight or cast shadow, no mockup. Completely opaque background. Visually balanced centered composition suitable for favicon, rounded app icon, and social branding.
